label: No reflexive actual giving of a bearer's own being
definition: For each world v accessible from selected w, every candidate c and moment t, f.GivesAt v c c t is false. This is irreflexivity of the strict concurrent giving-of-being relation; it is not a general ban on circular explanatory structures, temporal feedback, self-maintenance or members standing in other causal relations.
note: Primitive analytic candidate; interpreted as a standard strict efficient-/esse-causation constraint rather than a logical law or an assumption that a necessary being exists. Its metaphysical warrant is assessed separately.
